format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this palette, like "meadow". It matches the file name.

ink.description: The one near-black an "ink" edge, eyes and brows are drawn in, as # and six digits, like #222323. Left out means the darkest shade in the palette.

id.description: A name for this colour, like "tan" or "moss".

items.description: A shade, as # and six digits, like #885041.

colors.description: The colour's shades, from dark to light. A figure is shaded with them.

ramps.description: Every colour this palette has, each as a ramp of shades.
